title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Employment Relations and Law
description: This course focuses on understanding employment relations as guided by law.
longDescription: This advanced professional course covers a range of topics, including the origin and aims of employment law, principles of employment law, employment legislature, payment-related regulations, and the impact of ethical requirements on HR policies. Additionally, we'll explore key aspects of employment protection and dismissal, such as the various types of dismissal, reasons for fair and unfair dismissal, and steps for dismissing an employee. In our course, you'll also delve into the intricacies of employment contract terms, including the types of employment contracts, contractual and express terms, key terms of the employment contract, and employee rights. We'll also examine the relationship between employment law and organizational legal structure, including the sources of UK employment law, types of recognized workers, and UK employment courts. Furthermore, we'll cover employee rights in labour law, including salary and benefits, holidays, sick pay, maternity and paternity leave, and employment discrimination.
